accessRowFingerprintBoundary: The four new ordered access-row SHA-256 values establish a fresh baseline. No prior row-hash exists in the previous read; equal counts alone do not prove every existing access row unchanged.
policyFingerprintBoundary: New15table policy/grant hashes are a fresh metadata baseline; historical policy/grant equality is not claimed.
boundary: Function-body hashes and RLS flags compare actual snapshots. Permission/content delivery/native/session/load and owner gates are separate.
